section_summary.extract_value: This preliminary analyses section reports data quality checks for a study with two subsamples. The text confirms no missing data in BAS-2 scores, minimal missing data in other variables (≤0.5%), and normal distribution of BAS-2 items and total scores. The two subsamples did not differ significantly on sex, age, or BMI, indicating comparable groups.
